title: Frankenstein Agent of SHADE #1 DC New 52 2011 Jeff Lemire J.G. Jones Cover
condition_description: Bright front cover with light handling wear; scuffing/edge wear on the black back cover. See photos.
description:
Frankenstein, Agent of S.H.A.D.E. #1 (November 2011), DC Comics - The New 52 first issue. Written by Jeff Lemire, art by Alberto Ponticelli; cover by J.G. Jones. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Converse DC Comics Joker sneakers ad.

Condition: bright front cover with light handling wear; scuffing and edge wear show on the black back cover (see close-up photo).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
